# Ahmad Farooq
> Developer based in Lahore. Builds websites, internal tools, and AI workflows.

## About
Ahmad Farooq is a developer who builds websites and the systems that run them: internal tools, automations, and AI workflows. He runs Zotir Labs and co-founded Kaivex Systems.

## Work

- Blackbox: Landing page conversion scanner
- Zotir Labs: Full brand and website for a web agency
- Kaivex Systems: Digital infrastructure for e-commerce agencies
